hashing.name: hash-sort-order
hashing.description: Entries given out of order. Sorting is by UTF-8 bytes: 'B' < 'a'; '-' < '.' < '/'; a proper prefix first; U+FF5E (EF BD 9E) before U+1F600 (F0 9F 98 80), the reverse of UTF-16 code-unit order; NFD 'e'+U+0301 before NFC U+00E9. Also more than 9 entries.
